partial.target_noise: 512-spp probe targets: single-render noise floor sun 37-42, spot ~28, broad ~26, multisun ~30 dB; K vs 4096-spp clean targets 24.96 dB vs 23.99 dB against the 512-spp targets on 16 probes (+1.0 dB); held-out first-event references 1024 spp: floor 33.3-33.8 dB (Yellow 29.3-29.7) - not limiting the held-out K-only metric (A_noise_floor.json, A3_clean_K_r1P.json, A_ref_noise.json)

supported_defects.D1_visibility: r1 pixel / port light visibility (origin 0.1 mm along the shading normal, any hit occludes) disagrees with the renderer's geometry on 2.7 % of pixel-light pairs (broad 1.9-3.3 %, multisun 2.6-6.2 %, sun / spot 0 %), always as false shadow; 34-58 % of the blocking hits lie within 1 mm (q10 20 micrometres) of the origin = near-coincident / overlapping Lego geometry. Consequence in the data: opaque pixels with all bits 0 carry real radiance in the 4096-spp renders (Gray / Sand mean 0.18-0.21 under broad); in held-out sun-only evaluation the kernel then places non-local light in shadowed opaque pixels (Gray shadow pred/ref 15.6, Sand 3.3; ~24 % of the K-only squared error). Rule 'ignore hits closer than 0.3 mm': disagreement 0.47 % (false shadow 0.2 %, false light 0.25 %) on the same 5,317 pairs (A5_vischeck_*.json, A6_visrule_*.json)
supported_defects.D2_box_frame: r1_train evaluates point / spot irradiance and directions of the BOX domain from canonical (box-local) positions while the light table is in world coordinates: E_canonical / E_world q10 / q50 / q90 = 0 / 0.5-0.6 / 1.9-3.9 under the broad family (40 of 101 lit-box training images); sun / multisun exact (A1_box_frame.json). The held-out box carries ~25 % of the K-only squared error, mostly as light predicted in shadowed box faces (pred/ref 422) through band / mid / glob terms

phase1_summary.unresolved: Yellow (Burley SSS radius 1.0 / 0.2 / 0.1 m on a 0.9 x 1.6 x 0.9 m object) carries 41 % of the held-out K-only squared error; red and green errors are similar (23.2 / 23.8 dB), re-weighting and dense quadrature do not help; no single implementation factor isolated

correction.name: renderer-consistent incident field of the Stage A supervision and the kernel inputs

parts.a_visibility: pixel visibility bits and port surface-sample visibility ignore occluder hits closer than T_MIN = 0.3 mm to the offset origin (k44_prep.visible_t); the held-out port sun fractions use the same rule (k44_eval_vis -> eval_vis_k44.npz); the held-out pixel visibility stays the historical renderer's own
parts.b_box_frame: box-domain point / spot light directions and 1/r^2 in K_loc and in the box port incident fields are evaluated at world positions (canonical + per-image box offset) (k44_train)

correction.why_one_correction: both parts restore the same quantity - the incident field the kernel is given must be the one the renderer applied - and they act on separable domains for the Lego endpoint: part b changes nothing in the Lego domain (offset 0), so the primary Lego endpoint isolates part a; the box endpoint is reported as the joint effect of a and b
correction.unchanged: kernel family and sizes, representatives (amendment 1), radii, bins, loss, optimiser, steps 24,000, batch, chunking, seed 0, passivity hinge 1.0 (K_r1P recipe), Stage A renders, references, coupling C (relation tables; the same near-hit question in C is out of scope), solver, evaluation arms and metrics

runs.seed_control: K_r1P_s1 = r1_train.py --passivity 1.0 --seed 1 on the r1 prep (no correction) - measures training-seed spread
runs.order: candidate first, then seed control (sequential on the 12 GB GPU)
runs.evaluation: r1_eval run for K_k44P with R1_EVAL_VIS=eval_vis_k44.npz; for K_r1P_s1 with the r1 eval_vis.npz; k44_decomp on every eval dir; k44_verdict

endpoints.primary: held-out T0 Lego-domain K-only vs first_r1 pooled display PSNR (k44_decomp 'Konly_dom:lego'); held-out T1 reported for sign consistency
endpoints.mechanism: held-out T0 opaque-shadow (Gray / Black / Light_brown / Sand / Brown, pixel shadow) mean predicted luminance and PSNR (k44_decomp 'opaque_shadow_mean_pred_lum', 'Konly_opaque_shadow')
endpoints.secondary: box-domain K-only PSNR (joint a+b); Yellow K-only PSNR; full-scene S_T0 | hist and | r1, D_stale / E_upd, F, R_RNA, signed change (r1_eval); probe PSNR (train.json final holdout); passivity rho_T0 (r1_eval)
endpoints.never_used_for_choices: held-out T1 and every evaluation number are read only after both trainings and evaluations are complete; nothing is tuned on them

decision_rules.IMPROVED: Delta_T0 = Konly_dom:lego(K_k44P) - Konly_dom:lego(K_r1P) >= max(0.3 dB, 2 s) AND Delta_T1 > 0 AND opaque-shadow mean predicted luminance reduced by >= 30 % vs K_r1P
decision_rules.NO_IMPROVEMENT: Delta_T0 < max(0.3 dB, 2 s) (a failed correction is valid evidence; the cause attribution is then reported as not confirmed by intervention)
decision_rules.MECHANISM_ONLY: opaque-shadow luminance reduced >= 30 % but Delta_T0 below the threshold
decision_rules.stability_guard: if rho_T0(K_k44P) >= 1 or any composed held-out solve diverges, report it; the K-only endpoint is still evaluated (it does not use the solver)

smoke_checks_before_long_runs: k44_prep on 3 held-out images: bits changed only from 0 to 1 (never 1 to 0 beyond the 0.25 % false-light rate) and agreement with the A6 Blender pairs >= 99 %
k44_train --max-steps 100 on prep2: loss finite, peak memory < 11 GiB, step time logged
k44_eval_vis: fraction of ports with a changed sun fraction reported
stop: report and stop at the decision; no further correction, no other architecture, no automatic next batch
